title: Restriction depends on listed coordinates
statement: Let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction, let $C$ be a list of coordinates, and let $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If $x$ and $y$ agree at every coordinate appearing in $C$, then fixing the coordinates in $C$ according to either vector produces the same restriction.
hypotheses_covered: C is a list of coordinates
x and y are Boolean-cube vectors
x and y agree at every coordinate in C
